name: Rapidfolio
long_description:
Rapidfolio helps banks and fintechs fully automate back-office workflows like fraud investigations, KYB/KYC and loan underwriting, with accuracy and auditability.

Built by fintech founders and operators, Rapidfolio is on a mission to ensure banks and fintechs scale their customer base without adding another back-office head count.

launches.title: Rapidfolio - AI Platform for Compliance, Operations, Risk & Fraud for Fintechs and Banks 🏦
launches.body:
Hi everyone 👋\
We're [Naveen](https://www.linkedin.com/in/naveen-qureshi) & [Frederik](https://www.linkedin.com/in/frederik-vanhevel/), fintech founders and operators building [Rapidfolio](https://rapidfolio.com/).\
\
**TL;DR:** Rapidfolio automates the most complex manual compliance, operations, and fraud processes that analysts perform at fintechs and banks today. We do this with 100% accuracy, speed, and auditability. We are previous founders and operators in fintech, and created Rapidfolio because we wished it existed when we were running Sable (S19).\
\
**Video:**\
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UBIfRhNh08>

\
**Our Ask:**\
**If you are a founder or operator at a fintech** **or bank** **who**\
i) has a pressing need to automate manual tasks due to high volume and/or,\
ii) needs to decrease the amount you spend annually on back-office staff or\
iii) you simply want to build solid automation to decrease human error\
Reach out directly: [founders@rapidfolio.com](mailto:founders@rapidfolio.com) or book a demo: <https://cal.com/naveen-qureshi/demo>

**——————-**

**The Problem** 

Fintechs and banks spend up to **30% of their revenue** on operations, compliance, risk and fraud back-office staff. The back-office performs manual processes like KYC and KYB reviews, OFAC/sanctions/watchlist reviews, fraud investigations, disputes and chargebacks, mortgage and loan underwriting, and sometimes even manual data input workflows, among others. The back-office scales as a function of the number of accounts held at the fintech/bank and quickly becomes extremely costly, time consuming, and error prone. 

Frederik and I lived this problem firsthand. **We started Rapidfolio because we wished it existed when we were running Sable (S19)!**

**Our Solution** 

Rapidfolio turns manual compliance, operations, risk and fraud processes into accurate, auditable, and automated flows. We’re running at **100% accuracy** in production. We provide the **end to end platform and services** to:

**1. Convert your existing procedure** into deterministic, automated, workflows in minutes.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=106986&key=user_uploads/334623/8df4940f-c6ec-41e1-a6a5-4ccd6476667b)

**2.** We generate dozens of **test cases**, including edge cases, and fully test the workflow.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=106986&key=user_uploads/334623/940aa8f9-9728-47ef-9a5c-81648c0b28b8)

**3.** Once tested, you can **trigger the workflow** to run it in whichever way you prefer - be it API, our scheduler, a JIRA ticket.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=106986&key=user_uploads/334623/2ee48bae-3d66-487c-9e70-9ab859eb0b02)

**4. You have full visibility and control:** all workflows are version controlled, and each action is auditable and traceable. You can include humans-in-the-loop where needed. All analytics live directly in your dashboard.

Rapidfolio provides “innate abilities” like automated web browsing, document reading/analysis, comprehensive summaries, human-level judgment, to name a few. Additionally, Rapidfolio integrates easily into your **existing tech stack**. We have built-in integrations with leadings operations, compliance and fraud vendors in the financial services industry.

We are SOC 2 compliant, and are **live with customers across the U.S. and Canada.**

\
**The Team:**

**Naveen Qureshi:** CEO and co-founder, Rapidfolio\
Previously was co-founder & CEO of Sable (S19) that I built, scaled and sold. After Sable’s exit, I built and launched additional credit products with [Seen.com](http://Seen.com). Ex Capital One, Amazon, Target. Columbia Business School.\
\
**Frederik Vanhevel:** CTO and co-founder, Rapidfolio\
Previously built the entire banking stack for two fintechs from scratch. First, as founding engineer at Sable (S19), where he shipped the entire banking stack in a record 3 months, pre-AI. And after Sable’s exit, with Seen.com. Fred also built internal tools for back-office staff at both fintechs, and is passionate about automating the more tedious workflows with Rapidfolio.\
\
Reach out directly: [founders@rapidfolio.com](mailto:founders@rapidfolio.com) or book a demo: <https://cal.com/naveen-qureshi/demo>
